prompt: Subject: Flower clouds in the sky Main Body: A 2:3 vertical realistic solo portrait. A clearly adult female leaping between floating flower clouds and a sea of clouds, with the character occupying about 70% of the screen. Clouds, giant flowers, a full moon, falling petals, and distant floating torii gates are naturally included. Adult fashion editorial photography and cosplay themes; characters maintain an adult age feel and must not represent underage images. Extreme camera positions only change the viewing angle and are not allowed to damage the natural human structure: the head-to-body ratio is about 6.8 to 7, limbs are realistically proportioned, and the jumping action conforms to the center of gravity and weight. Characters/Expression: The expression uses 'called out to during action': called out while leaping, eyes lifting from the front toward the camera, lips slightly open as if about to respond. Clothing/Posture: Low-cut deep V white-purple improved kimono, the main neckline on the chest is directly visible, and key areas are covered by a complete opaque inner layer; purple belt, white flower embroidery, white tabi socks, and straw sandals constitute the outfit. The low collar only shows the collarbone and neckline, not enlarging body contours. The character completes a turning action in the air, the body rotates sideways but the thorax faces the camera at about a three-quarter angle, legs naturally apart, one foot raised, and the other extended backward; kimono sleeves, belt ends, hair ends, and petals rise simultaneously. A replica blunt katana is swung horizontally to the right of the screen, the tip far from the character and camera, one hand gripping the hilt, the other naturally open to maintain balance. Hands have complete, naturally separated five fingers, no complex gripping. Background/Lighting: Floating flower clouds, sea of clouds, giant flowers, full moon, falling petals, and distant floating torii gates form the space. The main light comes from the frontal moonlight and soft fill light, the character's face receives continuous light with uniform transitions, and the clouds and petals maintain dreamy layers without forming light spots on the face. Composition/Lens: Full body, extremely low ground-level upward shot, elevation angle about 60 to 75 degrees, using 14-24mm ultra-wide angle but strictly suppressing distortion. The character is located in the center-right of the screen, the airborne action occupies the main subject, the deep V neckline on the chest remains visible as a clothing detail, and the face is still the only visual center. Character's head, shoulder line, upper body, waist/hips, legs, and sword body maintain the same movement perspective axis. Texture/Style: Extreme dreamy kimono portrait. Sea of clouds, giant flowers, petals, moonlight, and slight grain; strong motion but not plastic.
